description: This PHP source file defines a web page for configuring and managing Voice SIP Advanced Service Provider settings, including UI elements, form handling, and AJAX interactions for starting/stopping SIP client and applying configuration changes.

methods.name: Dm_data_get
methods.description: Retrieves current SIP and Voice Profile configuration data as an associative array.

methods.name: page_load_values
methods.description: Initializes form fields with current configuration data loaded from PHP variables.

methods.name: get_set_val
methods.description: Gathers current form input states and values into an object for submission.

methods.name: sipclient
methods.description: Handles AJAX request to start or stop the SIP client based on user interaction.
